reason: Requires real Waystones menu, inventory, loader adapters, and server-side teleport completion.

preconditions: Start a supported loader/profile with Waystones and this mod installed.
Create a survival player with one emerald block and one emerald.
Configure a teleport whose complete accumulated cost is ten emerald units.
steps: Open the real Waystones menu and execute the teleport.
Observe the final inventory only after the teleport commits.
Repeat with a forced post-charge teleport failure using the runtime test hook.
assertions: The successful teleport removes exactly ten emerald units across all accumulated cost callbacks.
The failed teleport restores exactly the units actually removed, once.
No non-currency stack changes and no emerald value is created or destroyed.

preconditions: Create one creative player and one survival player with fewer units than the configured cost.
steps: Execute the same paid teleport for the creative player.
Attempt it for the underfunded survival player.
assertions: Creative inventory is unchanged and the teleport may proceed.
The underfunded teleport is rejected before any slot mutation.
No refund receipt remains after the rejected attempt.
